name: Apify
description: Run web scraping and data extraction Actors and read their results.

methods.whenToUse: Use browser sign-in for the provider-hosted MCP server.
methods.guidanceMd: Sign in to Apify so runs use the account's Actors, datasets, and plan usage. Paperclip records the intended account boundary; the provider enforces what the signed-in account can run.
methods.label: Sign in with Apify
warnings: An Apify API token from Apify Console → Integrations, or browser sign-in. Running Actors spends the account's plan usage.

Apify's MCP server collects telemetry about tool calls and MCP clients, and it is enabled by default. This connection opts out with telemetry-enabled=false on the server URL; that is Apify's opt-out, not a Paperclip telemetry setting.
Running an Actor spends the account's plan usage and can incur charges on metered plans.

methods.whenToUse: Use a restricted customer-owned key when browser sign-in is not suitable.
methods.guidanceMd: Open Apify Console → Integrations, copy an API token, and paste it below. Runs made through this connection spend that account's plan usage.
methods.label: Use an API key
